name: What is the process for restoring water damaged laminate flooring?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for restoring water damaged laminate flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The restoration process typically begins with water extraction using specialized equipment. Next, affected areas are thoroughly dried with industrial air movers and dehumidifiers to remove all residual moisture. Professionals monitor moisture levels to ensure complete drying. If the damage is severe, affected planks will be removed and replaced. Finally, the area is cleaned and sanitized to prevent mold and mildew. An inspection confirms successful restoration.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves water extraction, thorough drying, potential removal and replacement of damaged planks, and final cleaning and sanitization.
